about: The closed list of fillers an interview take is counted for. Each is a vocalised hesitation, matched as one whole word after lowercasing and keeping only letters and digits. Lexical fillers (like, you know, so, basically, I mean) are left out: telling them from their ordinary use is judging, which the model does (LEVERS, #2162). This file is the canonical copy (#2934); home's transcriber cites it for the fillers its prompt keeps (#2933).
